Are you an experienced Buyer or Procurement Specialist
with a background in complex technical environments?

Tintschl Technik GmbH is continuously looking for procurement professionals to support exciting projects with leading companies in the aerospace industry.

This position is part of our talent pool for current and upcoming aerospace projects.

Your Tasks

- Management of procurement activities for components, materials and/or services within aerospace projects
- Preparation and execution of requests for quotation and supplier selection processes
- Negotiation of commercial conditions, prices, delivery schedules and contractual terms
- Management and follow-up of purchase orders throughout the procurement lifecycle
- Monitoring of supplier performance regarding cost, quality and delivery
- Identification and mitigation of procurement and supplier-related risks
- Coordination with Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing and Finance
- Support of sourcing strategies and supplier development activities
- Preparation of procurement analyses, reports and KPI monitoring
- Participation in supplier negotiations, reviews and escalation meetings
- Ensuring compliance with internal procurement processes and customer requirements

Your Profile

- Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Engineering or a comparable qualification
- Professional experience in Procurement, Purchasing, Strategic Sourcing or Commodity Management
- Professional experience within the aerospace or aviation industry is highly desirable
- Previous Airbus procurement experience or experience working within the Airbus supplier environment is strongly preferred
- Good understanding of procurement processes, supplier management and commercial negotiations
- Experience with SAP or comparable procurement/ERP systems is an advantage
- Strong negotiation, analytical and communication skills
- Independent and structured working style with a strong sense of responsibility
- Comfortable working in international and cross-functional environments
- Fluent English and German is required
Professional careers do not always run perfectly or in a straight line.
Therefore, apply now, even if you do not match to all the requirements mentioned!

What we can offer you

- A standard permanent employment contract with a multi-award-winning employer (Kununu Top Company 2026, Focus Top National Employer 2026, etc.)
- Above-tariff remuneration with attractive bonuses
- Continuous personal support through a fixed contact person
- Increasing holiday and Christmas bonus within the first 4 years
- Bonus payment "Employees recruit employees" up to 1,000 EUR
- Company pension plan
- Possibility of home office in agreement with our clients
- Flexible working hours through a personal flexitime bank account
- Individual further training opportunities
- Option of permanent employment at our client´s company

That sounds like a challenging task for you?
Then we are looking forward for your application! Send us your cv, your salary expectations and your possible starting date by e-mail, by mail or directly via our career portal.

For further information, please visit our website www.tintschl.de or call 0800 898 8980 free of charge.

This is Tintschl
The Tintschl Group with its headquarters in Erlangen has stood for premium service competence in the fields of human resources, engineering and IT since 1997. Our employees are specialized in the implementation of technically and organizationally demanding projects for our nationwide customers.

For us as an employer, equal opportunities are an essential part of our corporate culture and the key to a diverse and inclusive working environment. We promote diversity, inclusion, work-life balance and equal opportunities for all people.

Find the perfect job with us and apply.

We look forward to welcoming you.

What to Expect

Tesla's retail stores are more than sales floors, they are the physical expression of our brand, our products, and our mission. As Regional Retail Program Specialist you will support the connection between EMEA retail marketing strategy and real customer experience on the ground. As part of the Central Europe Sales Operations team, you will work alongside the Customer Engagement, CX, Infradev, and local store teams to help ensure that every program, every asset, and every touchpoint tells a consistent, curated story from the moment a customer walks in the door.This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role that requires presence in market. You will travel regularly within Central Europe to support program rollouts, conduct brand standard checks, and build the kind of trusted local relationships that help EMEA strategy land.

What You’ll Do

- Support the consistent implementation of brand standards across all locations in Central Europe
- Support the implementation of retail programs in market, including new product launches, seasonal campaigns, and evergreen initiatives
- Coordinate retail refresh initiatives and brand asset distribution across locations in Central Europe
- Conduct regular store standard checks across each location and report field observations, learnings, and local market dynamics to the relevant teams
- Support and inform different stakeholders on new and existing store developments, helping ensure retail standards and educational elements are integrated
- Support the piloting of new retail concepts and sales tools locally, and help facilitate best practice sharing across markets
- Build and maintain comprehensive database of brand assets and equipment for each location in Central Europe

What You’ll Bring

- 1–2 years of experience in retail marketing, operations, or a related field - ideally within a consumer brand, automotive, or tech environment
- Good understanding of in-store brand experience, consumer journey, and retail standards
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities, with support from senior team members
- Highly collaborative - comfortable working across functions including marketing, operations, design, and facilities
- Organised and detail-oriented, with a hands-on approach to execution and follow-through
- Willingness and ability to travel regularly within Central Europe — this role requires a consistent in-market presence
- Proficiency in German & English; additional regional language is a plus

About Hays:

Our many years of recruitment experience and our expert knowledge of the engineering job market make us a strong partner for engineers and technicians. We maintain close relationships with customers across all industries and therefore can provide engineering specialists with exciting projects and attractive job opportunities, drawing on your personal interests and experience. As your professional companion, we support you throughout the entire process, from the first contact to the first day on your new job - all this completely free of charge. Register now and look forward to many interesting and suitable positions and projects.

What to Expect

As Operations Coordinator, Fleet you will help provide our customers with an extraordinary product experience through our internal fleet of vehicles for showroom, events, test drives, mobile rangers, and other purposes. As part of the Central Europe Operations team, you will be responsible for running our fleet operations in the region (DACH and Eastern Europe) and work with our EMEA and local sales and service counterparts to help assign and organize fleet vehicles in the right locations. You will also be responsible for managing their lifecycle into our used car sales process.We offer:

- Career Development & Training: At Tesla, you have the opportunity for personal and professional growth through regular performance reviews, targeted training measures, and further education options (e.g. high-voltage training, management training).
- Company Culture: Immerse yourself in our inspiring company culture, where innovation, teamwork, and passion are at the center.
- Innovative Projects & Technologies: You have the chance to work on groundbreaking projects and technologies that help shape the future of the automotive industry and sustainable energy.
- Benefits & Additional Services: You can expect a competitive salary and benefits package that includes Tesla stock or a Cash Award, access to our Corporate Benefits program, 30 days of vacation, a 13th monthly salary, as well as the option of a company pension scheme and a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket.
- Committed Team & Positive Working Atmosphere: Work in a dedicated and motivated team characterized by a great atmosphere and excellent teamwork. Be part of a team that contributes to a sustainable future and renewable energies.

What You’ll Do

- Fleet Organization: You organize and manage our internal fleet of test drive, showroom, loaner, mobile ranger, and other vehicles
- Cross-Team Collaboration: You collaborate closely with the Registration Team, Used Cars Specialists, Logistics, Local Operation Coordinators, Sales & Service Managers, and other fleet teams
- Efficient Allocation: You keep our fleet allocations clean, ensuring we get the most efficient use out of our vehicles
- Visibility & Oversight: You maintain visibility into all our fleet operations, including the locations of vehicles, the state of the cars, and any actions needed to improve the car or change its use
- Project Support: You support ad-hoc fleet-related projects such as car shows, events, Giga Factory Fleet, and others
- Inventory & Process Improvement: You assist with periodic physical inventory Fleet Audits and continuously improve processes and data structures
- Remarketing Integration: You cooperate with the remarketing team, integrating the vehicle trade-in and resale process to drive allocation of vehicles to various teams (Service, Supercharging, Giga Berlin, etc.)

What You’ll Bring

- Drive & Initiative: You are highly motivated and a self-starter with a strong desire for constant process improvement and the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
- Industry Passion & Delivery: You are passionate about the automotive industry, bring cross-functional experience, and have a proven ability to drive initiatives to conclusion
- Process Expertise: You have a solid understanding of business processes and are highly attentive to detail, enabling you to understand and improve workflows.
- Relationship Building: You have the ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with both internal and external partners
- Technical Proficiency: You work proficiently with MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and possess advanced computer skills
- Communication Skills: You have strong oral and written communication skills in English; knowledge of German is a plus
- Relevant Experience (Plus): Knowledge of vehicle registration processing and vehicle insurance claims is a plus

Performing inspections and repairs with a strong team in your back.Together with the Facility Management team of BTEC, you will improve the reliability of the equipment and systems to minimize or even avoid unplanned downtime.

- Speak and read in German and English

What to Expect

Location: BerlinTime Type: Full TimeDuration: 6 monthsStart Date: October 2026Our internship program is built on a simple belief: the best talent should not have to wait to do meaningful work. We place exceptional students in roles where they contribute to real outcomes - working side-by-side with dedicated managers, mentors, and cross-functional teams to accelerate their growth both technically and personally. From day one, you will not be watching from the sidelines. You will own projects, drive decisions, and make a visible impact. Join our Infrastructure Development team and take a central role in shaping Tesla's physical expansion across Central Europe. Reporting to the Real Estate Lead for Central Europe, you will support the real estate strategy across Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic, Romania, and Slovakia - primarily Tesla Centers and Delivery Centers, plus ad-hoc requests such as offices or warehouses. You will help identify, evaluate, and secure locations that bring Tesla's products and services directly to our customers. Activity is heaviest in Germany and Poland, with work across the wider region. This is not a passive support role. As a Real Estate Intern, you will own real deliverables and leave a tangible mark on Tesla's Central European footprint.

What You’ll Do

- Drive location search campaigns across Central Europe (Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic, Romania, and Slovakia) - identifying, evaluating, and shortlisting sites for Tesla Centers, Delivery Centers, and occasional offices or warehouses. 
- Serve as a coordination hub between internal stakeholders across teams and the eight Central European markets, keeping new and existing location projects moving forward on time. 
- Build compelling Real Estate Packages for leadership approval - clear, complete, and ready for decision. 
- Tackle ad hoc infrastructure challenges head-on, solving local operational problems with resourcefulness and speed. 
- Manage and review an active portfolio of leases, addendums, and renewals - with the precision that multi-market expansion across Central Europe demands. 
- Spot inefficiencies in existing programs and tools - and take ownership of fixing them, making the team faster and smarter. 
- Support site visits and external communications with landlords, developers, and brokers across Central Europe - preparing materials and joining negotiations as needed. 

What You’ll Bring

- Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a Bachelor's or Master's programme in Real Estate, Finance, Business Management, Architecture, Economics, or a comparable field.
- Full professional fluency in English - written and spoken. German, Polish, Czech, or Slovak is a strong plus.
- Confident working in Excel and the Microsoft 365 suite (Outlook, PowerPoint, Word, Teams). You are organised, detail-oriented, comfortable managing competing priorities, and drawn to operations and infrastructure. Prior internship or project experience is a plus.
- A valid driver's license and readiness to travel across Central Europe about four days per month for site visits and project support. You take initiative, thrive with a high bias for action, welcome feedback, and are eager to learn, adapt, and collaborate across functions and borders.
- A real passion for innovation, sustainable mobility, and the energy of building something that matters - in a fast-moving team that sets the pace.
- Available full-time from mid-September or October 2026 for a minimum of six months.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Design Engineering Internship, High Voltage Distribution/Battery Engineering (m/w/d) (Sekretär/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

Duration: min. 6 months Time type: Full TimeStart date: Oct 1st 2026Tesla is seeking highly motivated engineering students who thrive in a fast-paced environment and want to apply mechanical concepts to real world projects. Our team drives collaboration with many engineering groups - team players only. Tesla moves quickly, so being self-motivated and disciplined is critical. You must be passionate, but direction changes quickly, so you must also be resilient. As an intern you will work directly with full-time engineers to design, prototype, test and launch new parts and processes to improve our batteries. Our projects include advanced cooling systems, cell interfaces and high voltage distribution. Every day we push the boundaries of what is possible for energy storage in our vehicles, demanding extreme attention to details and the highest standard of performance, quality and manufacturability.

What You’ll Do

- Design new battery components that improve product metrics (performance, cost, mass)
- Own basic testing and analysis; support advanced testing and analysis
- Develop various test jigs and fixtures to validate battery components
- Design 3D/2D models of complex parts and assemblies
- Root cause test failures and process/manufacturing issues
- Collaborate with other teams inside Tesla (manufacturing, testing, NPI, supply chain, etc.)
- Create sources of truth to reference important findings

What You’ll Bring
